mechanism: Empagliflozin may increase urinary glucose excretion and osmotic diuresis, potentially affecting fluid balance and renal perfusion, while atomoxetine increases norepinephrine levels which can elevate blood pressure and heart rate, creating additive cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, renal function, and urinary glucose levels regularly; counsel patients on hydration status and signs of volume depletion or diabetic ketoacidosis.
